title: Selected PR1094: complete two-role whole-helper swap census (no improving swap)
body:
## Scope

Exact finite census of the **unordered two-role whole-helper swap** move class on the selected [PR 1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094) owner map (the exact map of `research/complex-t16-rare-pattern-exchanges/`), with all 144 call times, helper widths, source-event windows and the local paid word fixed. This is the move class `research/frontier1094-single-relocation` explicitly lists among its non-exclusions. Package: `research/frontier1094-swap-census/`. Base main `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`. No kappa, supplier or selected-frontier change.

Task card: `selected-packing` (chooser OS nonce `5faf82d91e84b5186f43a7c029914c43`, priority revision 3), scope **refined** to one bounded residual move class (TASK.json declares the refinement and reason). Coordination claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18920710 (expires 2026-10-14 11:45 UTC; a DONE update follows this PR).

## Result

**No unordered swap of two whole helpers between distinct owner bins strictly reduces the idle moment, for any real `0<a<1`.** Complete pair accounting over all `C(69120, 2) = 2,388,752,640` unordered role pairs:

| Category | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| Same-bin swaps (no-ops) | 88,345 |
| Capacity-infeasible | 1,570,734,429 |
| Strictly improving for every `0<a<1` | 1,150 |
| Neutral for every `0<a<1` | 816,035,605 |
| Strictly worsening for every `0<a<1` | 1,893,111 |

All 1,150 capacity-feasible improving pairs fail the **strict source-event window** rule (`lo < position < hi` on at least one landing); the active-pair and per-call family rules are never reached, so the obstruction holds with those two restrictions relaxed. The 1,150 pairs come from five role classes `(own-bin remainder, width)`: `(1,7)x(3,4)` 377, `(1,7)x(7,8)` 1, `(3,9)x(7,4)` 754, `(7,4)x(7,9)` 12, `(7,8)x(7,9)` 6. No swap touching a zero-remainder bin can improve, and the 4,866 empty rank-48 bins are outside this class entirely.

Method: a swap moves net rank `d = w1 - w2` between bins `x1, x2`, preserving the sum; strict concavity of `t^p + (S-t)^p` (`p = 1-a`) makes the sign uniform for every real `0<a<1` and an exact integer comparison of maxima. Completeness is an exact accounting identity over 87 role-class rows; the materialized improving list has exactly the analytic count.

## Evidence and controls

`CERTIFICATE.json` records the inherited [PR 1091](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1091) baseline recount, all 87 class rows, every 1,150 improving pair with both landing checks and rejection reasons, the positive fixture and eleven inherited owner mutation controls. Thirteen test groups (`test_verify.py`), including:

- an exact two-square-root radical oracle at `a = 1/2` on the 3,472 feasible integer quadruples of its grid;
- a toy brute-force pair enumeration matching the class-count tabulation;
- the pair-aware family rule (a same-call swap is a bijection and must not read as a collision; a cross-call collision binds when the window is muted);
- strict window endpoints, certificate tampering, a suppressed candidate, and source-drift rejection.

Negative-result positive fixture: a real legal swap (roles `(5,4,139)` and `(7,14,296)`, remainders `1+7 -> 2+6`, strictly worsening) is applied in memory; the inherited owner audit accepts the changed map with its recounted idle histogram, and the census on that map reports the same pair as a legal strictly improving swap (its inverse). Swapping back restores every bin remainder and the audit passes again. These maps are controls, not admitted constructions.

## Packing cap (acceptance gate)

The pinned calculator `research/complex-local-word-ceiling/ceiling.py`, called as `ceiling(local, 73, 896, 9, 64)` on the audited per-call local profile `{1:2412, 2:418, 3:432, 4:142, 5:82, 8:8}`, gives `a < 0.001690054109089`, i.e. `kappa < 0.001687202645325402` (+0.87% over the selected kappa `0.001672660197076918`). This census realizes **0.0** of that headroom: no legal swap improves the idle moment at all. The linear `a < D/E` supplier diagnostic does not apply to a fixed-word repacking; the packing ceiling is the applicable budget.

## Verification (Windows, CPython 3.13.15 and 3.12.14; standard library only)

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/frontier1094-swap-census/verify.py
# PASS_PR1094_SWAP_CENSUS_OBSTRUCTION pairs=2388752640 possible_gains=1150 legal_gains=0 positive_control=natural_legal_worsening_swap no_new_kappa
python3 -I -O -B research/frontier1094-swap-census/test_verify.py
# Ran 13 tests ... OK
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/frontier1094-swap-census
# PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/frontier1094-swap-census outcome=negative-result
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/frontier1094-swap-census --check-only
# PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS
python3 -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py
# PASS selected record, exact kappa ... 836330098538459/500000000000000000
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
# Ran 42 tests ... OK (skipped=2)
```

All were run fresh at the submitted head; default verification regenerates every certificate byte in memory.

## Limitations

- Finite census of unordered two-role swaps between distinct bins only. Not excluded: legal neutral paths among the 816,035,605 capacity-neutral pairs followed by an improving move, three-or-more-role cycles, within-bin slice repacking, different call orders, changed local words, helper splitting, idle-axis transfers.
- No new kappa, supplier admission, hosted invoice, cold replay or multiplication-theorem obligation. The selected record is unchanged. This is not a global packing optimum or an impossibility theorem beyond the stated class.

## Open next questions (in the package)

1. Neutral-then-improving two-step moves: filter the neutral pairs by the same landing rules, apply each legal one, and enumerate newly possible improving pairs on the changed map.
2. Three-role cyclic transfers: derive the majorization sign rule for cyclic transfers with `sum d_i = 0` and count capacity-feasible improving triples (needs a window/family join designed first).
